description:
GreenWidgets Co. is launching a company blog and needs a subdomain set up. Create a new sub-server (subdomain) called 'blog.greenwidgets.test' under the existing parent virtual server 'greenwidgets.test'.

Requirements:
- Domain name: blog.greenwidgets.test
- Parent server: greenwidgets.test
- Administration password: BlogPass2024!
- Description/Owner: GreenWidgets Company Blog
- Features to ENABLE: Web virtual server (Apache), DNS domain, MySQL database

Use the Virtualmin interface to create this sub-server. Navigate to 'Create Virtual Server', select 'Sub-server' (or 'Sub-domain'), and fill in the details. Ensure all three features (web, DNS, MySQL) are enabled.
